notes: Card: peaks on ' by' in 'directed by'/'written by', 'Dir.' + name, 'writer/d|irector', 'collabor|ator' right before a person's name; the logit effect suppresses ' shot', ' wide' (camera vocabulary). Near misses are film sentences with no credit slot before a name.
